tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything outside a game stage.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and the secondary button face.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented-control track, code and proof blocks, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls: at least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (hints, meta, timestamps) on surface and surface-raised; over 6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels on surface-raised; 4.5:1 minimum, so still readable.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. Primary buttons, prize amounts, links, and everything that means verified or fair. Text on it uses on-lagoon.

tokens.name: lagoon-press
tokens.usage: The pressable edge under lagoon buttons and tap targets. Not a text colour.

tokens.name: lagoon-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for positive chips (results in, collected) and the winner's row. Text on it uses lagoon-strong.

tokens.name: lagoon-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lagoon-soft, over 5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-lagoon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lagoon fill. It flips to dark ink in dark mode because lagoon lightens there.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Time and urgency only: the LIVE dot, the last ten seconds of a countdown, 'ends soon'. Never for money or success.

tokens.name: flare-press
tokens.usage: The pressable edge under a flare fill.

tokens.name: flare-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for live and ending-soon chips. Text on it uses flare-strong.

tokens.name: flare-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on flare-soft.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Text on a flare fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed verification and destructive host actions. Always pair it with an icon and a word, because its lightness is close to flare.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banners and field error wells. Text on it uses danger-strong.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Alias of lagoon: in FairDrops, success and fairness are the same colour. Always pair it with a check icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, drawn with a 2px offset; over 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes. On stage-* grounds the ring switches to on-stage.

tokens.name: stage-dice
tokens.usage: Game-stage ground for Dice. Stages are dark in both themes, so a player sees at once which game is running.

tokens.name: stage-quiz
tokens.usage: Game-stage ground for Quiz.

tokens.name: stage-tap
tokens.usage: Game-stage ground for Tap Rush and other speed games.

tokens.name: stage-custom
tokens.usage: Game-stage ground for third-party games that bring no stage colour.

tokens.name: on-stage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any stage-* ground, at least 9:1.

tokens.name: on-stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on stage-* grounds (round counter, hints).

tokens.name: stage-glyph
tokens.usage: The faint per-game pattern drawn on a stage ground. Decorative only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One moment per screen: the win reveal, the giveaway title on its own page (desktop).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles and the giveaway title on mobile.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Play the games, climb the board, collect your prize.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Winners are picked by score, and anyone can check the result.
styles.usage: Default running text. Never smaller in form inputs, so iOS does not zoom.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip text and table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, hints under fields.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows over sections. Maximum three words.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: Game timers, live scores, tap counters.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Prize amounts in cards and rows, in the display face with tabular figures so columns line up.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Addresses, hashes and proofs, only inside the Details and Verify views.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related inline items; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked rows in a list; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards and sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a card; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding and the win-reveal breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Game stages, bottom sheets, the win card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, the tap target.

shadow.note: FairDrops has one signature shadow: the solid 'press edge' under anything you can press, which makes buttons feel like arcade keys. Pressing moves the face down by the edge height and removes the edge.

tokens.name: edge-lagoon
tokens.usage: Press edge under primary (lagoon) buttons.

tokens.name: edge-neutral
tokens.usage: Press edge under secondary buttons, segmented-control thumbs and answer tiles.

tokens.name: edge-flare
tokens.usage: Press edge under flare fills (Tap Rush target).

tokens.name: edge-danger
tokens.usage: Press edge under destructive buttons.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: sheets, menus, toasts, the sticky claim bar. Cards stay flat with a line outline.

duration.note: Motion is springy and quick. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration collapses to 0ms except fades, and nothing bounces.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Button face moving down on press.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, chip changes, toggle thumbs.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, cards entering, score ticks.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: The one orchestrated moment: leaderboard reveal and win card.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Pops: score +1, tap target release, chip becoming 'Prize ready'.
